messages:
morgan: Heads up — hit a weird parity issue between JS and Python SDKs on fncall + json_mode. Sample app onboarding fails when trying to call the create_ticket tool.

jia: Repro steps?

morgan: Repro: JS SDK (1.2.0) returns structured object as expected; Python SDK (0.9.3) returns a stringified JSON (escaped) and our schema validator in samplekit rejects it: "Invalid JSON schema: expected object, got string".

sam: Is this the retry/auth wrapper double-encoding we saw earlier? Which middleware stack does py use?

morgan: Py uses auth->retry middleware. Logs show the replayed request body is a stringified JSON. Example:
```
request to runtime:
{
  "json_mode": true,
  "tool_call": "create_ticket",
  "input": "<stringified JSON>"
}
```

jia: Looks like the retry layer is calling json.dumps on an already-serialized body.

harper: We can make the runtime more tolerant, but we should fix the py SDK. @luis can you take a look at defensive check before serializing?

luis: Yep. Quick fix: in retry middleware, only json.dumps if body is not a str/bytes or if content-type is application/json and body is a mapping. I'll open PR and add unit test in sampleapp.

deploy-bot: CI: sampleapp-tutorial (py) failing 2 tests related to fncall-schema.

morgan: For immediate onboarding, I'll add a small shim in the sampleapp bootstrap to do:
```
if isinstance(resp, str):
    resp = json.loads(resp)
```
so users don't get blocked.

jia: :thumbsup: Create a ticket for the SDK parity bug and link PRs? #6342

luis: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/4876 — patch + tests. ETA EOD.

harper: I'll add a runtime regression (accept stringified payloads for a short window) and a lint rule to catch json.dumps-on-str in middleware.

morgan: Thanks all — will update the onboarding guide and release note once PR merges.
